children: OKLAHOMA CITY, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Riley Exploration Permian, Inc. (NYSE American: REPX) ("Riley Permian" or the "Company") today announced that its Board of Directors has approved a cash dividend on the Company's common stock in the amount of $0.42 per share. The dividend is payable on November 11, 2026 to stockholders of record as of the close of business on October 28, 2026. This represents a 5% increase from the previous dividend of $0.40 per share that was distributed the four quarters prior, with the most recent being August 12, 2026.
Additionally, the Company plans to release financial and operating results for its third quarter on November 4, 2026 after the U.S. financial markets close.

In connection with the earnings release, Riley Permian management will host a conference call for investors and analysts on November 5, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. CT to discuss the Company's results and to host a Q&A session. Interested parties are invited to participate by calling:
